segments.en:
rough — in great joy!" — the writer breaks into the intimate Yiddish vernacular for this final exclamation; take means "truly, really"; ahayli is an intensifier meaning "properly, the real thing, in full measure" — not just to be there but to conduct oneself fully and properly; the Yiddish carries an urgency and loving insistence that the sacred Hebrew cannot quite match at this moment]
